snippet.title: Pig Boss — Official Gameplay Trailer | Corporate Horror Game
snippet.description:
Pig Boss is a story-driven corporate horror game set in the nearly empty offices and laboratories of GoodHeart Medical. Employees are disappearing, the labs hide dark secrets, and your boss is not what he seems.

Explore the building, uncover the truth, make choices, and experience a story with multiple endings.

Wishlist Pig Boss on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5560570/Pig_Boss/?beta=1

Press kit: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15PkZnAwFFwgdTTzUB9gcuMygod6rLuu-?usp=drive_link

The game will be available in English, Russian, and Simplified Chinese. This gameplay trailer is in English.

First-person gameplay • Realistic visuals • Developed with Unreal Engine 5 (UE5).


MUSIC: Knock Knock by Dmitry Taras

#PigBoss #HorrorGame #OfficeHorror
